description: Infiniti Oracle is the AI-native market intelligence layer for prediction markets. This feed publishes hourly briefings on Polymarket, Kalshi and beyond — major market movements, volume records, regulatory and legal developments, new notable markets, and high-signal political, economic and crypto predictions — plus live commodities and crypto stats blocks tracking gold, oil, natural gas and BTC/ETH/SOL price action.

items.title: $1B+ in crypto liquidations as BTC wobbles near $82K
items.summary: Over $1.09B in crypto positions were liquidated in 24h as Bitcoin slid from ~$86K toward $82K before recovering to ~$82,991 Friday afternoon; longs ate ~85–86% of the losses (~$930M), the largest single wipeout a ~$20M ETH position on Hyperliquid. Trigger: US authorities transferred 17,733 seized BTC (~$1.48B) to Coinbase Prime over three days, spooking a market already jittery on geopolitics .

items.title: Zacharia probe still live: Kalshi & White House stay silent
items.summary: WSJ's piece on the three suspiciously timed Katie Zacharia bets ($19→$1,896; $74/$80→$3,689/$4,023) was updated within the last hour, but Kalshi's spokeswoman still declines comment and the White House hasn't responded; the separate CFTC probe into billions in near-identical crypto "wash trades" on Kalshi also looms .

items.title: Oil holds its diesel-deal losses into the weekend
items.summary: Brent eased ~0.7% to ~$103.53 and WTI settled near $91.20 after Trump's announced Putin diesel-supply deal; traders still weigh Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and Hurricane Isaias against the Iran de-escalation .

items.title: Gold's rally holds above $4,200; silver above $60
items.summary: Gold futures closed +1.5% at ~$4,220 on easing yields and a softer dollar; ETF inflows have run 12 straight weeks and the PBOC bought for a 23rd straight month .

items.title: CFTC probing possible "wash trading" on Kalshi
items.summary: Per the NY Post, the CFTC has launched a probe of unusual trading activity on Kalshi after billions of dollars of near-identical crypto trades raised questions about possible wash trading; the item surfaced in Friday's reporting on the Zacharia probe, alongside Kalshi's fresh "we can't comment on ongoing investigations" line to the Post .

items.title: Kalshi's press-secretary probe: still no new comment

items.title: Trump announces Putin diesel-supply deal; oil eases into the close
items.summary: Trump said he struck a deal with Putin for Russia to supply diesel to US and global markets, sending WTI down 0.4% to ~$91.20 and Brent down 0.4% to ~$104; Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and Hurricane Isaias still hang over supply .

items.title: Kalshi probes suspicious trades on Trump's press secretary pick
items.summary: Kalshi has opened an investigation after the WSJ found at least three small but well-timed wagers on conservative commentator Katie Zacharia being named White House press secretary, placed before the NYT reported the pick at ~2 p.m. ET Friday; a $19 bet placed ~10:43 p.m. Thursday is slated to pay $1,896, and two Friday bets ($74, $80) expect $3,689 and $4,023. Zacharia had been priced near 1% on Kalshi; Trump confirmed the appointment in a Truth Social post Friday afternoon .

items.title: Norway moves to block Kalshi, Polymarket and 60 other unlicensed sites
items.summary: The Norwegian Gaming Authority notified 62 companies that their sites could face DNS blocking for serving Norwegian consumers in breach of gambling law; the regulator has already blocked 238 gambling sites, and companies have until Oct 15 to respond before a final decision .

items.title: Vol on Tennessee vs Arkansas: markets love the Vols but split on details
items.summary: Polymarket and Kalshi both price No. 15 Tennessee at 83% to beat Arkansas on Saturday; Kalshi has $56,245 traded on the game as of Friday, less than 6% of the Texas game, and the QB-news move hit first-quarter markets (-7 pts on the Vols) while the winner contract hasn't moved all week .

items.title: Kalshi's tribal prediction-app push details: four ventures named
items.summary: Oklahoma's PokkeTrades (Alabama-Quassarte), Greenville Rancheria's Greenville, Alturas Indian Rancheria's AIR Markets, and Kletsel Dehe's Sovereign Edge; each venture owns its app and branding while Kalshi provides trade matching, clearing, custody and surveillance .

items.title: FCA confirms UK entry talks as prediction markets push back on gambling label
items.summary: FCA markets chief Simon Walls confirmed the regulator is discussing potential UK entry with prediction-market operators (Oct 6); the FCA's 2026 perimeter report classified the financial prediction-market products it examined as binary options still subject to the 2019 retail ban .

items.title: 39 states side with New Jersey against prediction markets in SCOTUS brief
items.summary: 39 states filed an amicus brief backing NJ in its fight with Kalshi, urging the Supreme Court to let states restrict sports-event contracts; separately, TickerTracker shows Kalshi at ~$2.18B (parlays 60.9%, sports 19.8%, crypto 16%) and trailing 7-day volume of $18.5B for Kalshi vs $2.65B Polymarket US .

items.title: Kalshi launches prediction apps with Native American tribes, dividing Indian country
items.summary: The Kletsel Dehe and three other tribes in California and Oklahoma launched prediction apps with Kalshi on Wednesday, breaking ranks with hundreds of other tribes that say platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket are illegally encroaching on tribal gaming rights; tribal casino gaming generated $46B in revenue in 2025 .

items.title: Kalshi and Polymarket eyeing ~$20bn valuations in new funding talks
items.summary: Per the WSJ, both platforms are in early talks with investors; Kalshi's Dec. Series E raised $1bn at an $11bn valuation, Polymarket's ICE deal valued it above $8bn, while Flutter is down >60% and DraftKings down ~45% over six months .

items.title: Polymarket counter-sues Massachusetts in federal court
items.summary: Polymarket filed Monday in the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts against AG Andrea Campbell and gaming officials, arguing the Commodity Exchange Act gives the CFTC exclusive jurisdiction over event contracts; CLO Neal Kumar: "Congress gave the CFTC, not states, exclusive authority over event contracts" .

items.title: Kalshi's 15-minute gold markets out-fee ether markets 2:1
items.summary: The short-duration gold contracts, launched weeks ago, generated nearly twice the trading fees of Kalshi's Ether-linked markets in September, with the live 15-min gold market showing $140,707 volume .

items.title: Traders trim year-end gold optimism as prices slide

items.title: Tennessee–Arkansas markets split on QB uncertainty
